issues.description: Class Bitmap24 field 'data' has conflicting types: the template header declares 'int *data;' while the template implementation (Bitmap24.cpp) allocates and uses a byte buffer with 'new char[...]' and performs byte-level indexing. The reference solution's header declares 'char *data;'. This mismatch will cause compilation/type errors and confuses students which element type to use for the image buffer.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template header declaration to match the implementation and solution: replace 'int *data;' with 'char *data;'. Ensure any code comments and usages in the template consistently treat 'data' as a byte buffer (char*) and rebuild to verify compilation. This preserves the pedagogical intent while removing the type mismatch that would prevent successful compilation.
